body:
## What a user saw (#1840)

After pricing a trip and submitting it, the header still said *"Trip setup is saved. Nothing has been planned yet."* and *"Look over the starting options"*. *"Approval is not ready yet."* gave no reason. Setup promised "route and cost options" and said "Dates drive cost estimates", and Compare carried a banner about "flat per-day rates" above cards reading "Not priced". The planner has made no cost estimates since #1829.

## Change

The view model now receives the entered price record (`build_trip_prices_payload`, already read for the workspace, so no extra query) and the public proposal outcome. The header advances:

| state | next step | opens |
|---|---|---|
| no price entered | Enter the prices you have | Budget |
| priced, business, not submitted | Submit for approval | Policy |
| blocked by policy | Fix what the policy flagged: TPP's own reasons + rule codes | Policy |
| policy service unreachable | Submit again ("nothing was reviewed") | Policy |
| compliant | Print the approval packet | Policy |
| priced, leisure | Compare the route options | Compare |

- "Approval is not ready yet" now names the first step not done.
- `blocked_by_policy` is read from the public payload, where the raw transport status is debug-only (#1130 / #1152), so the approval summary no longer says "not ready" for a trip the policy refused.
- Setup copy rewritten to what the planner does now (measures the route; you enter prices). Flat-rates banner and its CSS removed.
- `handleNextStepAction` gains a `budget` target.

## Gates

| gate | break | result |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/app/test_trip_prices.py`: served payload, the header advances after `PUT /prices` | `_next_step` ignores prices | fails (6 backend tests in total) |
| `tests/app/test_workspace_readiness.py`: each stage, blocked names reasons, not-ready reason | same | fails |
| `NewTripPage.test.tsx`: no "cost estimate" / "route and cost options" / "transport cost" | restore "Dates drive cost estimates" | fails |
| `WorkspacePage.test.tsx`: "Open Budget" selects the Budget tab | — | pass |

Three existing tests pinned the old copy and were updated to the truthful strings.

Local: backend 1510 passed / 2 skipped; mypy and ruff clean; complexity guard passed (13 changed functions, max 23); frontend tsc clean, vitest all passing.

Fixes #1840

title: The workspace header advances with the trip; setup stops promising cost estimates
